title: S03T01 - Ratify one canonical storage, synchronization, and conflict contract
description: Reconcile object-store, file-store, ledger, cache, and SQLite plans into one current writer and collaboration boundary with explicit generations, content hashes, conflict identity, and non-goals.
acceptanceCriteria: One authoritative contract names the canonical writer, collaboration artifacts, caches, lock domains, generation model, and remote synchronization protocol.
Superseded storage plans are marked historical and all public docs point to the ratified contract.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
